[EN] Ruins and relics are fascinating, to be sure, but hardly worth risking one's life over. Very few people benefit from becoming famous after their deaths.
[ES] Las ruinas y las reliquias son fascinantes, sin duda, pero apenas vale la pena arriesgar la vida por ellas. Muy poca gente se beneficia de volverse famosa después de morir.

[EN] How do I take all this research with me...?
[ES] ¿Cómo me llevo toda esta investigación conmigo...?

[EN] Shona. It's good to have you with us. Let's hurry!
[ES] Shona. Qué bueno que estás con nosotros. ¡Démonos prisa!
